title: 9 Castles in Europe Worthy of Their Icon Status
content:
Dozens of castles in Europe dot the landscape, each with a story carved into stone, wood, and legend. These aren’t just ruins of the past; they’re full-blown time machines, and they sit proudly in cities, on hillsides, and by rivers waiting for curious visitors.
From fairy tale silhouettes to dramatic strongholds, these structures were originally built for defense or royal life. Today, they offer panoramic views, day trips, and guided tours that blend history with wonder.
